description: KPI and Evidence Governance Baseline - Operationalize continuous KPI and evidence governance so cycle-time, quality, and release-readiness artifacts remain fresh, comparable, and auditable.

userStories.title: Define recurring KPI/evidence governance cadence and ownership
userStories.description: As a release owner, I want up-to-date evidence so release decisions are based on current data.
acceptanceCriteria: Governance cadence and ownership for KPI/evidence refresh are defined
Recurring routine keeps weekly trend, quality evidence, and release-readiness artifacts synchronized
researchTopics: Current ownership boundaries for KPI/evidence refresh across roadmap and release workflows
Existing scheduling/automation points for recurring governance checks
userStories.notes: Derived from PRD-034 goals and acceptance criteria. Depends on PRD-033 governance alignment.

userStories.title: Preserve KPI comparability constraints across governance updates
userStories.description: As a quality reviewer, I want comparable KPI snapshots across periods.
acceptanceCriteria: KPI comparability assumptions/constraints are explicitly defined and enforced in governance routines
Artifact freshness checks cover weekly quality, release, and KPI outputs
researchTopics: Comparability assumptions currently used by KPI measurement and dashboard artifacts
Failure modes that break period-to-period KPI comparability
userStories.notes: Depends on PRD-015 KPI/dashboard artifact semantics and PRD-029 release gate contract consistency.

userStories.title: Surface stale or missing evidence with deterministic remediation guidance
userStories.description: As an operator, I want missing/stale evidence to be detectable early.
acceptanceCriteria: Stale or missing evidence is surfaced with explicit remediation guidance
Governance output provides deterministic GO/NO_GO decision support signals
researchTopics: Best signal format for deterministic GO/NO_GO readiness decisions
How to map evidence freshness failures to actionable remediation guidance
userStories.notes: Aligns governance outputs with release-owner and operator decision workflows.
